subject.title: feat(android): render LaTeX display math in chat via bundled KaTeX

question: Should this protected-label Android display-math PR require lint-cleared WebView security review and real Android visual proof before merge, or should maintainers explicitly override one of those gates?
rationale: The change is user-visible, routes assistant content through a JavaScript-enabled WebView bridge, and the PR body still says pixel rendering is unverified.

options.title: Require fix and visual proof
options.body: Fix the fallback and lint/security blockers, then require a redacted Android emulator or device screenshot/recording showing valid display math and invalid-math fallback before merge.

options.title: Override proof after code fixes
options.body: A maintainer can accept unit/build evidence after the code blockers are fixed, but Android chat rendering would remain unproven in a real setup.

options.title: Pause for Android proof lane
options.body: Hold the PR until an authorized Android device or emulator proof path is available.

recommendation.title: Require fix and visual proof
recommendation.body: Fix the fallback and lint/security blockers, then require a redacted Android emulator or device screenshot/recording showing valid display math and invalid-math fallback before merge.
